name: Olympia Capital Holdings Ltd
source: Issuer audited consolidated statement of financial position, KShs thousands converted to absolute KShs. FY2026 and FY2025 from the OCHL 2026 audited financials, FY2024 from the audited summary published on the Nairobi Securities Exchange.
source_note: Current and non-current totals are the issuer component sums: FY2026 non-current 330 plus 38,348 plus 83,508 equals 122,186 and current 7,328 plus 18,456 plus 37,960 plus 23,377 plus 18,184 equals 105,305; FY2025 non-current 581 plus 38,837 plus 88,939 equals 128,357 and current 6,979 plus 11,654 plus 51,322 plus 11,679 plus 13,695 equals 95,329; FY2024 non-current 7,144 plus 35,378 plus 8,679 equals 51,201 and current 23,072 plus 46,600 plus 10,856 plus 1,600 equals 82,128. Accounting identities checked before writing and tying exactly in all three years: non-current plus current assets equals total assets, non-current plus current liabilities equals total liabilities, total liabilities plus total equity equals total assets.
